paths.name: next-intl
paths.message: `@kynite/ui` is not localised. Every user-visible string arrives as a prop, so the app translates and the package renders. (Storybook has no next-intl provider, and never will.)

paths.name: next-intl/server
paths.message: `@kynite/ui` is not localised. Every user-visible string arrives as a prop, so the app translates and the package renders.

paths.name: server-only
paths.message: `@kynite/ui` is client/presentational code — there is no server module in it.

patterns.message: `@kynite/ui` must render outside a Next tree (Storybook). A component that needs a link takes Base UI's `render` prop and lets the app pass `next/link`; a component that needs an image takes `src` and a `render` prop the same way.
The package may not import from the app. It is the *dependency*, not a consumer: anything it needs has to move into `packages/ui` (or be passed in as a prop).
